defendant: GEORGE K. CRUTCHER A/K/A GEORGE CRUTCHER AND ORA MAE CRUTCHER, HIS WIFE; GE MONEY BANK; STATE OF NEW JERSEY; CF NETWORK ISSUANCE TRUST
description:
Tax Lot 88 Block 24201 F/K/A Lot 6 Block 1469
Dimensions of the Lot are (Approximately) 30 X 79.43 AV
Nearest Cross Street: Garfield Ave.
The sale is subject to unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water and sewer liens and other municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority. The occupancy status of the subject property is unknown.
The approximate upset sum is $489,246.83 calculated through April 27, 2026 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriff's cost and commission to the date of sale.
